desktop.decision: Keep parallel CPU and GPU hardware probes on Windows. Fork median health 5677 ms, parallel 4032 ms. All four pairs improved and hardware fields matched. Browser render medians about 425–437 ms; no demonstrated render speedup.

host_timing.method: Four pairs of cold App Host processes with fresh isolated profiles, bundled Node 24.12.0, real Windows hardware probes and no active cloudflared. Window and model startup are outside the timed interval. Health and tunnel state validated. All eight Host processes exited successfully via the shutdown endpoint.

decisions.engine: Main has no changes since the installed 0.1.63 source.
decisions.ple: Use mmap for the working installation. It halved median engine readiness in warm restarts. Both inference lengths fall within or overlap the RAM control range. Nearly full 256K was qualified with the same GPU reserve.
decisions.int8: One run ended slightly faster; it does not establish a repeatable gain. The selected profile uses Q4 KV.
decisions.app_host: Use the complete Windows tasklist CSV for the absence fast path. Active connectors and ambiguous lists use existing CIM. Active real tunnels were not timed and the fast path targets a process without a connector.

candidates.decision: The Pascal restrict fix is present in the current pdl.hpp and native CUDA kernels.
Windows unbuffered expert reads target low free RAM. The local arena load reports file-cache hits and substantial available RAM.
The Pascal dense FP32 path is already enabled in the saved profile.
The 4 KiB arena prefault does not engage with current 2 MiB large pages. Dense upload and early arena are independent pieces with external startup results.
Host checkpoint reuse for parked conversations. The Windows result used a different checkpoint policy, so this profile needs an alternating-conversation test before a port.
Automatic prefix pins across independent requests. Separate from retaining a parked conversation with the existing 2048-token threshold.
Elastic CPU Vision. The local profile keeps CPU Vision resident.
Bounds host RAM during swaps. No speed result for the current 256 GiB profile.
Local Strata owners report normal I/O priority. A forced priority override has no demonstrated benefit.
External Ivy Bridge int8 result on another GPU. Included a native int8 arm here.
Windows GPU-to-CPU Vision fallback. The installed profile selects CPU Vision directly.
